founders.bio: Co-Founder & CEO at Papaya (YC F26). Previously led GTM and Ops at SafeBase from $0-10M ARR and through its acquisition. Also led analytics products at HqO and managed investments for AmEx Digital Labs. UMich undergrad and HBS MBA.

founders.name: Niyaz Puzhikkunnath
founders.bio: Founder at Papaya. Previously Sr. SDE at Amazon for 10+ years building large-scale ML systems across Computer Vision, Classification, LLMs/Agents. Led teams on brand and product classification, built agent evaluation workflows, and created a self-service ML training pipeline. Earlier, one of the first engineers at Zovi.com, where he helped build the front-end architecture and internal analytics.

founders.name: Faiz Vadakkumpadath
founders.bio: Founder at Papaya (YC F26). Previously Senior Data Engineer at Amazon for 10 years, leading teams for the enterprise Data Lake, solving problems at Exabyte scale. Earlier scaled Vodafone's MPESA mobile money system in Africa from 25 to 200 tps at IBM. Co-founded OpenReporting, a SaaS financial reporting tool.
